question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` become the supported public plugin-SDK subtype for transient tool notices?
rationale: The generic typed subtype avoids unsafe text inference and the existing boolean status field is too broad for Slack reaction mapping, but adding a callable public SDK contract and taxonomy requires explicit long-term ownership intent.

options.title: Approve the generic subtype
options.body: Keep the additive tool-progress kind and predicate, then require current-head Codex-to-Slack proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign the notice taxonomy
options.body: Pause this PR and replace the boolean and progress-kind surfaces with one owner-approved closed notice-kind model across producers and channels.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic subtype
recommendation.body: Keep the additive tool-progress kind and predicate, then require current-head Codex-to-Slack proof before merge.
